title: Brief Peace
physical_identity: A thin straight strip of pale tropical sand in an infinite, nearly static turquoise ocean under a clear sun; periodic gravestones; tended by a tall tendril-armed black being. All via narrator testimony.
scale_topology: Outdoor; endless straight sand spit (walked for hours without change) in a boundless ocean; no other land.
anomalies: gravestones for forgotten people from other worlds appear along the strip
a being buries and etches headstones, carries survivors away
levels' sand shrinks to a needle when swimming away
lighting_sound: Clear bright tropical sun, basic blue sky gradient, no clouds; small waves near shore, still sea beyond; stagnant wind. Other sound not stated.

entities.name: Unnamed tall black tendril-armed being
entities.behavior: About 10 ft, mute, buries forgotten people, saves and carries Holly away

entities.name: Vantablack figure
entities.behavior: Glimpsed briefly on awakening; likely the same being

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: one non-hostile tall black being (single-witness testimony)
hazards: sun and fatigue on long walks
items_communities: headstones with epitaphs and small accessories (photographs)
level reserved as Level 100 by Holly Clove, pending approval

entrances.method: Jumped from a cliff into the ocean while picturing a beach, arrived on the sand strip
entrances.conditions: single testimony; no early level used
entrances.quote: She pictured the beach, and took a final step.

exits.method: Swim out to near-drowning; the black being carries her away
exits.conditions: single testimony; requires near-death and the being
exits.quote: gently wrapped its tendrils around her waist

signature_mechanic: An endless motionless strip of sand and sea with long-spaced graves; wandering is fruitless, and the only way out is exhausting oneself swimming until a gentle mute being rescues and carries the player away.
do_not: make the being hostile or vocal
show the cliff or abuse scenes
conflicts_notes: Holly first says the level was only sand and water, then later reveals graves and the being. No entrance/exit sections; edges derived from narrative. Link list includes nav entries (Level 99, 101).

key_quotes.quote: a thin, straight stretch of sand in an infinite, nearly static ocean
The tide never rose or anything, and the wind was pretty… stagnant.
I got to this level directly from Earth.
The static ocean water gave her no pushback
The creature was at least ten foot tall
You do it for people who are forgotten, don't you?
I'd like to take the number 100.
